column1: # The valid range of `rounds` at the LIBRARY boundary. SPEC.md §6.1 is
# normative; this file is the machine-readable copy the drivers read.
# Every row is a library call hashing "abc" (24 bits) from the standard IV with
#   expect    accepted | rejected            (| separates permitted verdicts)
# `unrepresentable` is a permitted verdict only where the row says so: Lean's
# round count is a `Nat`, which cannot hold a negative number at all, so the
# negative row is not a test it can run. That is recorded as its own verdict
# rather than counted as a rejection, because "the type forbids it" and "the
# code checks for it" are different claims and only one of them transfers to
